propositions: The Git version floor gate step exits 1 with '::error::missing' when .github/git-version-floor.txt is absent from the checked-out patchset tree, despite the workflow definition being sourced from main.

Every in-flight change branched before the floor gate merged (c433663721) fails Verified -1 hard, regardless of whether the change touches git-version-related code, because the patchset lacks the floor file.

The gate must implement an if-present guard (established repository pattern documented in ee2a) that skips with a log line explaining tree-skew and re-enforcement on rebase, rather than hard-failing on absent floor file.
An under-floor git version must still be detected and fail with a diagnostic naming the required version, installed version, and upgrade path when the floor file is present.
